fine_classes: Actinic Keratosis, Basal and Squamous Cell Carcinoma
Psoriasis, Lichen Planus and Related Conditions

dataset_audit.split_group_rule: pHash Hamming <= 8 union normalized filename stem

comparison.protocol: Every candidate is trained on the same train split, calibrated on the same val split, and scored once on the same held-out test split. The deployed model is the candidate with the best val composite. final_model holds the scores of the saved classifier graph itself, run end to end over the val/test photos.

previous_deployed_bundle.caveat: Trained on an earlier split, so some of these val/test images may have been in its training data; these numbers can only be optimistic for it.

as_shipped.note: The saved classifier graph scored end to end on val/test (orig + flip), exactly as the scanner runs it.
